summary: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3.7 Flash, the latest point release in its Flash model series aimed at coding and agentic workflows, at an introductory price that is half the cost of the prior Gemini 3.6 Flash.

mechanisms.reason: The post states a concrete price figure — half the cost of the prior Flash model — which is the clearest form of stated inference economics.
mechanisms.quote: with an introductory price at half the original cost of 3.6 Flash

practices.reason: A new Flash model version is available with stated lower cost, relevant to teams building coding and agentic tools on Gemini Flash.
practices.quote: our latest workhorse model for coding and agentic workflows, with an introductory price at half the original cost of 3.6 Flash

notable_reason: A named price halving for a widely-used workhorse model is a concrete, quotable inference-economics data point.
